name: Haunted Divinity
source:
A narrative-driven visual novel centered on Venarok, a fallen god of poison and knowledge long feared for the monsters born of his sorrow.

Secluded within a sanctum woven from venom and memory, Venarok has long abandoned mortal affairs—until an unexpected connection draws him back into a world he no longer understands. Through choice-driven storytelling, you will shape how he responds to intimacy, vulnerability, and the quiet pull of change.

[Edited from [url=https://tsunamijuria.itch.io/haunted-divinity]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部以叙事驱动为核心的视觉小说，围绕堕落的剧毒与知识之神维纳洛克展开——长久以来，世人都对他悲恸中所诞生的怪物畏惧不已。

隐居在由毒液与记忆编织而成的圣所中，维纳洛克早已不问凡间俗事——直到一段不期而遇的羁绊，将他重新拉回了这个他已不再理解的世界。通过选择驱动的叙事体验，你将亲手塑造他面对亲密关系、内心脆弱以及悄然降临的改变时所做出的回应。

[摘自[url=https://tsunamijuria.itch.io/haunted-divinity]itch.io[/url]（经编辑）]
